XFAIL Known defect: API answers 500 instead of 400 for invalid payloads

AssertionError: assert 500 == 400
 +  where 500 = <Response [500]>.status_code
 +    where <Response [500]> = create_booking({'lastname': 'Doe', 'totalprice': 150, 'depositpaid': True, 'bookingdates': {'checkin': '2026-03-01', 'checkout': '2026-03-05'}, ...})
 +      where create_booking = <api.booking_api.BookingApi object at 0x70666ffa4920>.create_booking

XFAIL Known defect: IDs are parsed leniently ('1abc', '1 OR 1=1' resolve to booking 1)

AssertionError: assert 200 == 404
 +  where 200 = <Response [200]>.status_code
 +    where <Response [200]> = get_booking('1abc')
 +      where get_booking = <api.booking_api.BookingApi object at 0x7fd813410fb0>.get_booking

XFAIL Known defect: IDs are parsed leniently ('1abc', '1 OR 1=1' resolve to booking 1)

AssertionError: assert 200 == 404
 +  where 200 = <Response [200]>.status_code
 +    where <Response [200]> = get_booking('1 OR 1=1')
 +      where get_booking = <api.booking_api.BookingApi object at 0x7fc59d579b80>.get_booking
